title: Cochain representative formula for normalized derived mates
statement:
For two ordinary adjunctions and their normalized derived adjunctions, assume comparisons of the left functors and invertible comparisons of the exact right functors with their termwise cochain functors. A compatible ordinary square and derived right square determine a derived left mate. Its composite with the first left comparison and exact vertical factorization equals the second left comparison followed by localization of the ordinary left mate. This holds on every cochain complex, without requiring exactness of either ordinary left adjoint.

Precise formal conclusion with its module-variable context (notation is that of the cited statement dependencies):
```lean
universe a av b bv c cv d dv a' av' b' bv' c' cv' d' dv'
variable {A : Type a} [Category.{av} A] {B : Type b} [Category.{bv} B]
  {C : Type c} [Category.{cv} C] {D : Type d} [Category.{dv} D]
  {AD : Type a'} [Category.{av'} AD] {BD : Type b'} [Category.{bv'} BD]
  {CD : Type c'} [Category.{cv'} CD] {DD : Type d'} [Category.{dv'} DD]
  {L₁ : A ⥤ B} {R₁ : B ⥤ A} {L₂ : C ⥤ D} {R₂ : D ⥤ C}
  {LD₁ : AD ⥤ BD} {RD₁ : BD ⥤ AD} {LD₂ : CD ⥤ DD} {RD₂ : DD ⥤ CD}
  {G : A ⥤ C} {H : B ⥤ D} {GD : AD ⥤ CD} {HD : BD ⥤ DD}
  {QA : A ⥤ AD} {QB : B ⥤ BD} {QC : C ⥤ CD} {QD : D ⥤ DD}
theorem derivedMate_comparison
    (a₁ : L₁ ⊣ R₁) (a₂ : L₂ ⊣ R₂) (ad₁ : LD₁ ⊣ RD₁) (ad₂ : LD₂ ⊣ RD₂)
    (ε₁ : QA ⋙ LD₁ ⟶ L₁ ⋙ QB) (ε₂ : QC ⋙ LD₂ ⟶ L₂ ⋙ QD)
    (ρ₁ : QB ⋙ RD₁ ≅ R₁ ⋙ QA) (ρ₂ : QD ⋙ RD₂ ≅ R₂ ⋙ QC)
    (γ : QA ⋙ GD ≅ G ⋙ QC) (η : QB ⋙ HD ≅ H ⋙ QD)
    (h₁ : ∀ P K (f : L₁.obj P ⟶ K),
      ad₁.homEquiv _ _ (ε₁.app P ≫ QB.map f) =
        QA.map (a₁.homEquiv _ _ f) ≫ ρ₁.inv.app K)
    (h₂ : ∀ P K (f : L₂.obj P ⟶ K),
      ad₂.homEquiv _ _ (ε₂.app P ≫ QD.map f) =
        QC.map (a₂.homEquiv _ _ f) ≫ ρ₂.inv.app K)
    (τ : TwoSquare R₁ H G R₂) (τD : TwoSquare RD₁ HD GD RD₂)
    (hτ : ∀ K,
      τD.app (QB.obj K) ≫ RD₂.map (η.hom.app K) ≫ ρ₂.hom.app (H.obj K) =
        GD.map (ρ₁.hom.app K) ≫ γ.hom.app (R₁.obj K) ≫ QC.map (τ.app K))
    (ι : G ⋙ L₂ ⟶ L₁ ⋙ H)
    (hι : ∀ P, a₂.homEquiv _ _ (ι.app P) = G.map (a₁.unit.app P) ≫ τ.app (L₁.obj P))
    (P : A) :
    ((mateEquiv ad₁ ad₂).symm τD).app (QA.obj P) ≫
        HD.map (ε₁.app P) ≫ η.hom.app (L₁.obj P) =
      LD₂.map (γ.hom.app P) ≫ ε₂.app (G.obj P) ≫ QD.map (ι.app P)
```

proof.text: Transpose through the second derived adjunction. The derived right square representative equation and the two normalized Hom formulas identify the transpose with localization of the ordinary unit-mate equation. Naturality moves the comparison maps past the ordinary unit. Injectivity of the Hom equivalence proves equality.
